shortDescription: Manages https-rule objects on Checkpoint over Web Services API

options.name: action
options.description: Rule inspect level. "Bypass" or "Inspect".

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: blade
options.description: Blades for HTTPS Inspection. Identified by Name or UID of the blade.

options.name: certificate
options.description: Internal Server Certificate identified by Name or UID, otherwise, "Outbound Certificate" is a default value.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments string.

options.name: destination
options.description: Collection of Network objects identified by Name or UID that represents connection destination.

options.name: destination_negate
options.description: TRUE if "negate" value is set for Destination.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enable/Disable the rule.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings.

options.name: install_on
options.description: Which Gateways identified by the name or UID to install the policy on.

options.name: layer
options.description: Layer that holds the Object. Identified by the Name or UID.

options.name: name
options.description: Rule name.

options.name: position
options.description: Position in the rulebase.

options.name: service
options.description: Collection of Network objects identified by Name or UID that represents connection service.

options.name: service_negate
options.description: TRUE if "negate" value is set for Service.

options.name: site_category
options.description: Collection of Site Categories objects identified by the name or UID.

options.name: site_category_negate
options.description: TRUE if "negate" value is set for Site Category.

options.name: source
options.description: Collection of Network objects identified by Name or UID that represents connection source.

options.name: source_negate
options.description: TRUE if "negate" value is set for Source.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the access rule (present or absent).

options.name: tags
options.description: Collection of tag identifiers. Available from R81.20 JHF management version.

options.name: track
options.description: a "None","Log","Alert","Mail","SNMP trap","Mail","User Alert 1", "User Alert 2", "User Alert 3".

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
